description: Keyword search over Frontrun-discovered companies. Use scope "catalog" (recommended for discovery) to search every company YOUR tracked accounts have ever surfaced, which is far wider than any single time window of follows - companies describe themselves in plain words, so exact terms like "post-training", "fine-tune", "RL environments" often find what semantic thesis search misses. scope "tracked" (default) searches only entities in YOUR tracked accounts' follow graph. For "companies under N followers" questions this is ONE call: scope "catalog" + sector or keyword + max_followers=N - counts come back live-verified against X (followers_live: true), so do NOT re-check sizes with per-company calls; follow up with frontrun_founders_batch for all result handles at once. PRESENTATION: always show catalog results as a markdown table - Company (linked to x.com/username) | Description | Followers | Founders (@handles linked) | Website. Never a prose list. For broad thesis work, run BOTH frontrun_thesis_search and this tool with 2-4 keyword variants, then merge.

ai.description: Kind of AI company, one of: Foundation Models & Research, AI Infra & Compute, Agent Infra, Training Data & Annotation, Evals & RL Environments, Agent Builders, General Assistants, Vertical Agents, Coding Agents, Voice AI, Generative Media, Physical AI, AI Security & Safety. "any" = AI-native, "none" = no AI.

buyer.description: Who buys: Enterprise | SMB | Developers | Consumers | Government | Crypto users

crypto.description: true = onchain / token component; false = none

include_founders.description: Catalog scope only: include each company's founders (name, role, X handle) in the same response. Uses more usage per company with founders found

industry.description: Taxonomy industry (market served). "AI" = any AI-native company, or one of: B2B Software, Developer Tools, Fintech, Crypto, Consumer, Gaming, Commerce, Healthcare, Bio, Industrials, Aerospace & Defense, Energy, Hardware, Security, Education, Real Estate

keyword.description: Search keyword (matched against company name and bio/description)

max_credits.description: Optional spend ceiling for this one call. Fails closed: if the call could use more, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

max_followers.description: Catalog scope only: only companies at or under this follower count, live-verified against X

min_followers.description: Catalog scope only: only companies at or above this follower count, live-verified against X

scope.description: "catalog" = keyword search over your catalog of companies; otherwise whose follows to search: "tracked" (default), "network" (whole Frontrun network, paid Pro plans) or "list:<id>" (one of your lists).

sector.description: Legacy sector substring: "DeFi", "AI", "Robotics", "Infrastructure", "Payments", etc. Prefer industry / ai / sub.

sub.description: Taxonomy sub-industry, e.g. "Robotics", "Payments", "DeFi", "Legal", "Healthcare IT". frontrun_sectors lists them.

verify_followers.description: Set false to skip live verification of follower bounds (faster, counts may be stale). Default: true when a bound is set

name: frontrun_search
